import pytest
from target import unescapeHTML

# Helper to compare expected output with actual for various inputs
@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "input_str, expected",
    [
        # Basic known entities
        ("&", "&"),
        ("<div>", "<div>"),
        ("Hello "World"!", 'Hello "World"!'),
        # Multiple entities in one string
        ("a < b & c > d", "a < b & c > d"),
        # Unknown entity should remain unchanged
        ("&unknown;", "&unknown;"),
        # Entity with an internal '&' should not be transformed (old regex would skip it)
        ("&foo&bar;", "&foo&bar;"),
        # Mixed known and unknown/internal '&' entities
        ("Start & middle &foo&bar; end", "Start & middle &foo&bar; end"),
        # Entity at the end of string
        ("End >", "End >"),
        # Entity at the beginning of string
        ("<Start", "<Start"),
        # No entities
        ("plain text", "plain text"),
    ],
)
def test_unescapeHTML_behaviour(input_str, expected):
    assert unescapeHTML(input_str) == expected


def test_unescapeHTML_none():
    assert unescapeHTML(None) is None


def test_unescapeHTML_type_assertion():
    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
        unescapeHTML(123)  # not a compat_str (i.e., not a string)
